description: Maintain subgoal stage and prevent exhaustive search, wrong-object carry, and transform/put skip loops.

actions.code:
def hook(ctx, nb):
    nb['stage'] = 'find_target'
    nb['last_hint'] = ''
    nb['transformed'] = False
    nb['placed_count'] = 0
    text = 'Follow ALFWorld order: find the requested target type, take it, do any required clean/heat/cool/slice transform, go to the requested destination, then put it there. Do not take back an item after placing it.'
    return {'skills': [{'text': text}], 'tool_hint': 'When a target take, required transform, or destination put is available, use that subgoal instead of continuing broad search.'}
